Support

We're here to help you get the most out of DriveGuardian.

DriveGuardian helps drivers stay focused on the road, build safer habits, and keep families connected. If you have a question, run into a problem, or need help with your account, you'll find answers below — and you can always reach us directly by email.

Contact us

For any question, bug report, or account request, email our support team:

contact@mydriveguardian.com

We aim to reply within 1–2 business days. Please include your device type (iPhone, iPad, or Android) and a short description of the issue so we can help faster.

Getting started

  • Create an account. Open the app and sign up with your email, or use Sign in with Apple, Google, or Facebook.
  • Allow permissions. Grant Location and Motion access so the app can detect driving and calculate your safe-driving score. For live family location, allow "Always" location.
  • Start driving. DriveGuardian automatically detects trips and builds your activity, trip history, and weekly reports.
  • Invite your family. Create or join a family group to share live location and safety alerts with people you trust.

Frequently asked questions

Why isn't my location updating?

Live location needs the "Always" location permission and an active internet connection. On iPhone/iPad go to Settings → DriveGuardian → Location and choose Always, and make sure Precise Location is on. On Android, set location permission to Allow all the time. If location was stuck, fully open the app once — it refreshes immediately.

How is my safe-driving score calculated?

Your score reflects how safely you drive over time, based on distracted-driving moments detected during trips (such as handling the phone while driving). The more safe driving you do, the higher it climbs. Your score only changes when you actually drive.

What is a family group and who can see my location?

A family group lets people you choose see your driving activity, safety alerts, and live location on a map. Sharing only happens after you accept an invitation and sign in — it is always with your knowledge. You can leave a group or turn monitoring off at any time in the app.

I'm not receiving notifications.

Make sure notifications are enabled for DriveGuardian in your device settings, and that the app has been opened at least once after installing. On iPhone/iPad: Settings → DriveGuardian → Notifications → Allow Notifications.

Does DriveGuardian read my messages or calls?

No. We never read, collect, or store the content of your calls, messages, or notifications, who you talk to, or your contacts. The app only records that "the phone was used while driving," with the time and speed. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

How do I change or reset my password?

On the login screen tap Forgot password and follow the email link. If you signed in with Apple, Google, or Facebook, manage your password through that provider.

Managing your account & data

You are always in control of your data:

  • Delete your account. You can permanently delete your account and all associated data directly in the app — go to Profile → Delete account.
  • Access or correct your data. Email us at the address above and we'll help with any request.
  • Revoke permissions. You can turn off any permission in your device settings at any time; some safety features may stop working as a result.

Troubleshooting

  • Trips not detected: confirm Location is set to "Always" and Motion access is enabled, then take a short drive.
  • App feels slow or stuck: close and reopen the app, and make sure you're on the latest version from the App Store.
  • Still stuck? Email us with your device type and what you were doing — we'll get back to you.
